description: Track each supported n by witness source class so later claims can distinguish embedded exact payloads from theorem-backed algebraic constructions. This prevents provenance drift when the code base mixes exact data and constructive families.
implementation_hypothesis: Emit a machine-readable provenance map and a source audit for every supported n.
experiment_seed: Generate the provenance ledger over n<=100 and compare category counts before and after solver changes.
